entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, learned counsel for applicant and Sri Paritosh Malviya, learned AGA for State.

2. Applicant-Dileep Sahni has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 65 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Chitwara Gaon, District Ballia.

3. Applicant before this Court is in jail for about four years and eight months and is facing trial for offence of kidnapping and rape of a minor girl, aged about 14 years.
4.

This Court passed following order on 08.04.2024:
Dileep Sahni vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195462702/

entities.text: Dileep Sahni vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1. Applicant before this Court is facing trial for rape of a minor girl.
2. In the present case, victim is a minor girl aged about 14 years and in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has made specific allegations against applicant for rape.
3. Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 4.7.2019 i.e. about 4 years and 8 months.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that in the present case cognizance was taken on 14.10.2019 and he referred order sheet annexed along with supplementary affidavit filed on 28.2.2024 that up to 23.1.2024 despite case was listed on various dates, however despite non-bailable warrant issued to co-accused Sarita who has been granted bail has not appeared before Trial Court, therefore, Trial has not proceeded further and till date charges are not framed.

5. In aforesaid circumstances, let learned Trial Court submit a report within one week and Sri D.P.S. Chauhan, learned A.G.A. is directed to file a personal affidavit of Station House Officer concerned that under which circumstances non-bailable warrant issued to co-accused Sarita has not been executed till date.
6. List on 15.4.2024 at 12.30 P.M.
7. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.?
5. Learned AGA has filed a personal affidavit of Station Officer, Police Station Chitwada Gaon,
District Ballia, today, which is taken on record, that non bailable warrant was executed on co-accused, Sarita, who surrendered and granted bail with undertaking that she will attend trial.
Learned AGA further submits that statement of victim has not been recorded till date and for her testimony date is now fixed on 19.04.2024.
6.

Learned counsel for applicant refers the contents of FIR that on the date of alleged occurrence applicant was alongwith complainant and was helping him to search the victim and even he stayed overnight at his place and later on he consumed some poisonous substance but after proper medication he was survived.
Learned counsel submits that in aforesaid circumstances allegation that applicant kidnapped minor daughter of Informant and raped her, appears to be a false story.
However, it is not disputed that victim has supported case of prosecution in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and her statement in trial has not been recorded till date.
7. Learned AGA submits that in the present case bail application of applicant be considered only after statement of victim is recorded in trial.
8. In the present case, applicant is in jail since 04.07.2019 and till date even statement of victim has not been recorded in trial, therefore, it may be a case of prolong detention.

However considering Dileep Sahni vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195462702/
2 that trial could not be proceeded since one of the co-accused was not attending trial after she got bail and as referred above now she undertakes to appear and participate in trial regularly, therefore,
all the arguments raised before this Court can be appreciated only after statement of victim is recorded.

entities.text: Dileep Sahni vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. In aforesaid circumstances, the application is disposed of with direction that Trial Court concerned will record statement of victim either on the next date fixed, i.e., 19.04.2024 or within a short period thereafter.
The applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh on basis of statement of victim.
10. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 AK  Dileep Sahni vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195462702/
